name: The Hope Conspiracy
label: Deathwish
lede: Boston hardcore with a snarl and a reading list: four records in twenty-five years, a producer next door, and a singer who never stopped being angry.

eras.title: Four guys and a Godcity demo
eras.text: Bassist Jonas Feinberg and vocalist Kevin Baker start the band in late 1999. A three-song demo and a Converge-adjacent recording room get them to Equal Vision within a year.

years.src: Wikipedia · Iodine Recordings (The New Scene, Ep. 228) · Grokipedia
years.p: The Hope Conspiracy record a three-song demo in Norwood, Massachusetts: "Escapist," "Divinity Sickness" and "When the Doves Fly," later retitled "Regret Kills."
years.xp:
According to Wikipedia, the band pressed 1,000 cassette copies, and the demo later came out on CD and 7-inch through Aaron Turner's involvement.

Baker's earlier band was Piecemeal, per a 2024 interview on The New Scene podcast; Feinberg, per Grokipedia, had come out of a band called Harvest.

years.p: Bassist [[Jonas Feinberg|9ce65b6a-2494-4214-8180-765f33a5586c]] and singer [[Kevin Baker|f9206d8b-3a1d-4336-be61-7b656aa1b6e8]] start the band in Boston with guitarist Neeraj Kane, with Dan Zimmerman on guitar and Adam Patterson on drums.

years.h: Cold Blue: ten songs, 22 minutes, [[Kurt Ballou|1e922902-2cb9-499f-aeb5-9a8c51dd0df0]] at the board
years.p: Equal Vision Records puts out the debut on October 24, 2000. Kurt Ballou of [[Converge|fa31e7d4-a03a-4110-98fc-f8826e95ec25]] produces it.
years.xp: Exclaim! praised the band's approach, saying Baker's lyrics were "more poetic than preaching" against most hardcore of the day.

eras.title: Endnote and a shifting cast
eras.text: Bridge 9 and Equal Vision each get a record, guitarist Aaron Lisi and drummer Jarrod Alexander pass through, and by 2003 the band goes quiet.

years.p: Bridge 9 issues the short release between the two Equal Vision albums.

years.cap: Baker fronting the band in the Endnote years
years.p: Equal Vision releases the second album in autumn 2002; Punknews scored it 4.5 out of 5.
years.xp:
Wikipedia lists the release as October 17, 2002 on the band page and September 17 on the album page, so the file says 2002 only.

Drummer [[Jarrod Alexander|175a4ea4-8b0c-4d9b-b09e-625372f6ff44]], also of [[Suicide File|86336490-e9fb-41e3-9a81-8edfa56785ec]], is on the record; he later joined [[My Chemical Romance|c07f0676-9143-4217-8a9f-4c26bd636f13]] live in 2011.

years.p: The Hope Conspiracy share a 7-inch with Suicide File, on [[Jacob Bannon|d5c2a3e1-a52a-4af6-8e3f-aa2c4dc69af7]]'s Deathwish Inc..

years.h: Jim Carroll replaces Aaron Lisi on guitar
years.p: Jim Carroll joins in about August 2003 and moves into the practice space at 12 Wadsworth, where Feinberg lives.

eras.title: Death Knows Your Name
eras.text: Back with a fresh lineup and a new label, the band turn in the record fans still name first, then one more EP and a quiet exit.

years.p: Baker plays in Bars and Jared Shavelson drums for [[None More Black|a1f28c75-e6aa-4d63-9b01-3be42c599fab]] while the band sits idle.
years.xp: Grokipedia adds that Feinberg worked as a live sound engineer for Bleeding Through. Baker has described personal struggles during the break in an interview.

years.cap: Death Knows Your Name, Deathwish Inc., 2006
years.h: Death Knows Your Name: a year at Godcity
years.p: Recorded February 2005 to February 2006 with Kurt Ballou, it lands on Deathwish on September 19, 2006.
years.xp:
Baker said reference copies of Entombed's Uprising and Zeke's Till the Living End lay around the console. [[Dwid Hellion|1f27f407-dbbb-4d9a-b186-fdf5a613a855]] of [[Integrity|f626335d-d234-408d-a67c-37a3c2c7e98a]] recorded vocals for "Sadistic Sacred Whore" in Belgium over AIM.

Neeraj Kane and Tim Cossar had rejoined for the record.

years.p: A short EP from the same period; its "Eurohell" is the bonus track on the 2022 reissue of the album.
Deathwish releases the last record for fifteen years, again produced by Ballou.

eras.title: All Pigs Must Die and the long quiet
eras.text: Baker moves to All Pigs Must Die. The old band spends a decade writing sporadically before committing again.

years.p: The new band forms in 2009 with [[Ben Koller|b6fdd346-b9e8-449a-9105-612d3722503f]] of Converge, and Baker keeps the mic there through 2017.
The Hope Conspiracy commit to writing again in spring 2022; Kevin Baker says, "We aren't getting any younger."
years.xp: They recorded music in fall 2022 at Godcity; Baker later did vocals in a home studio.

years.p: Wikipedia dates the remastered reissue to 2022; it adds "Eurohell" as a bonus track.

eras.title: Tools of Oppression
eras.text: A new EP and a new album, both cut at Godcity, and the band play out after years without a stage.

years.p: The first new material in about fifteen years, engineered by Ballou and Zach Weeks.
Deathwish releases the fourth album in May 2024, recorded at Godcity with Ballou and Weeks.
years.xp:
Baker told New Noise it was the first time he could remember feeling that way about a record he worked on.

The album takes aim at oligarchy and late-stage capitalism; Baker cited "Killing Joke" among inspirations.

years.p: They tour North America and, per Grokipedia, Europe in 2025, after nearly fifteen years without shows.
